sources.t: Switching off 2G and 3G networks: advice for IoT and third-party device suppliers
sources.f: Published 22 January 2024 and updated 19 June 2026; Ofcom states UK 3G networks are switched off and 2G switch-off timetables vary by operator.
sources.g: Industry transition guidance and operator timetables do not establish current broadband or mobile service at an exact parcel.

sources.t: Signal struggles on trains widespread, Ofcom research finds
sources.f: Published 3 June 2026; Ofcom reports poor mobile performance across measured railway segments and defines its study thresholds.
sources.g: Route-segment research is transport-context evidence and cannot be promoted to fixed parcel service or address orderability.

sources.t: One million people have mapped their mobile – have you?
sources.f: Published 29 May 2026; Ofcom says Map Your Mobile combines crowdsourced experience data with predictive operator information.
sources.g: Postcode-district checker and crowdsourced/predicted mobile evidence is not exact parcel-level fixed internet truth.

sources.t: Switching off the UK’s 2G and 3G mobile networks: what you need to know
sources.f: Published 6 March 2024 and updated 29 May 2026; Ofcom states 3G networks are switched off and 2G networks will close on operator-specific timetables.
sources.g: Consumer transition advice does not prove service availability at a UPRN, address or parcel.

sources.f: Published 27 February 2024 and updated 29 May 2026; Ofcom sets industry expectations for the 2G and 3G transition.
sources.g: Regulatory expectations and national transition status are not exact-location connectivity measurements.

sources.f: Published 19 December 2023 and updated 27 May 2026; the page indexes annual, interim and planned-deployment infrastructure reports.
sources.g: An index and national infrastructure summaries require dataset-level and exact-location validation before parcel promotion.

sources.f: Published 13 May 2026; the report is a January 2026 snapshot of fixed broadband availability and mobile coverage predictions.
sources.g: National and regional snapshot metrics do not prove a current orderable service for an individual parcel.

sources.f: Published 17 October 2023 and updated 13 May 2026; the report describes operator plans through the following three years.
sources.g: Forward-looking operator plans are not current deployment, activation or exact premises orderability.

sources.f: Published 13 May 2026; the report projects full-fibre and gigabit-capable coverage based on operator plans as of January 2026.
sources.g: Projected coverage through 2028/2029 cannot be treated as present exact-parcel service.

sources.t: Premises contracted and built, Project Gigabit contracts
sources.f: Published 24 October 2025 and updated 20 July 2026; the page indexes monthly contract-level Project Gigabit delivery snapshots.
sources.g: Contract-level monthly management information is not current exact-address orderability evidence.
